title: Echo Hi Ku Hundza eMaboboni
intro: Anakanya hi nkova lowu eka wona ku vatliweke tindhawu to tshama eka tona emaribyeni, naswona moya wu rhwala xitsundzuxo xa xilemukiso lexi nga tekeriwiki enhlokweni. Vanhu va tshame va humelela laha, va katekile kambe va kaneta, ku kondza ku huma xikombiso eribyeni leri a va ri tshemba.
clues: A hi ri vanhu lava a va vatla makaya lama sirhelelekeke ku suka etintshaveni, hi titwa hi hlayisekile etindhawini ta hina to tshama eka tona leti nga ni maribye.
A hi tshama etikweni ra mativa ni maribye, leri katekisiweke hi swirhapa ni swihlovo.
Murhumiwa exikarhi ka hina u tile, a hi vitana leswaku hi tshika swikwembu swa hina swa mavunwa hi gandzela Muvumbi un’we wa ntiyiso.
Hi ku tikukumuxa hi veke xiyimo xa ripfumelo: xikombiso xo hlawuleka lexi a xi ta huma eka wona maribye lawa hi ma vatliweke.

Loko kamela ya xisati leyi tshembisiweke yi humelela eribyeni, xikombiso lexi nga erivaleni, vahlawuriwa va hina va ha arile naswona va n’wi tlhava hi swikunwana hambileswi a va tsundzuxiwile hi khombo leri tshinelaka.
Endzhaku ka masiku manharhu xiendlo xa hina, ku buluka lokukulu ku twala enkoveni, naswona hi hungutiwile hi va marhumbi lama weke, makaya ya hina ma va masirha ya hina.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
